detail.longDescription: RE: https:// mastodon.social/@tdp_org/11709 4097600822057 I tested this & *some* TVs *do* support Network Error Logging. Mostly Android-based models/sticks, vendors identified so far: - Amazon - Apple - Google - Lenovo - Samsung - Sony So you can get alerts on DNS, TCP, TLS & HTTP errors for at least some media clients. Not 100% but there's def enough coverage to be useful, indeed NEL spotted a brief outage we had due to power issues at origin (in realtime). We'll roll it out more widely as a next step in the PoC. # WebStats # NEL # WebDev # Streaming
